rationale: The continuation thesis is confirming mechanically: price has just broken the session low ($12.55 → $12.52, new lows of day), remains ~5% below VWAP and well under the falling 5m 9-EMA, with the risk-off tape (SPY -0.74%, VIXY +2.7%) still supportive, and no reversal signature (no volume capitulation spike or VWAP reclaim) has printed. The $12.30 target remains valid and only ~1.8% away, while the original $13.00 invalidation caps downside at roughly the same $150 risked at entry on a deliberately small position. The main caution is the drying 1m volume into new lows, which raises squeeze risk on a -19% gap name, but that alone is not enough evidence to exit or flip long against a live breakdown.
